description: Search scientific papers across OpenAlex (250M works, all fields), arXiv (preprints) and PubMed (biomedicine) in one call. Returns title, up to 5 authors, year, venue, DOI, landing URL, open-access PDF URL, citation count and abstract (up to 600 chars), merged and deduplicated by DOI. Params: query (required), source ('all' default, 'openalex', 'arxiv', 'pubmed'), limit (1 to 25, default 10), year_from, open_access_only (default false). Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"query":"retrieval augmented generation","limit":5}.

year_from.description: Only papers published in or after this year

name: paper_search
title: Scientific Paper Search
